uwCourse.title: Introduction to Algorithms
uwCourse.description: Design and analysis of algorithms: divide and conquer, dynamic programming, greedy methods, graph algorithms, NP-completeness.

foreignCourse.title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
foreignCourse.description: Algorithm design paradigms and complexity theory, including dynamic programming, graph algorithms, and NP-completeness.

topicCoverage.evidence: Brief mention in Week 3, no dedicated module
Weeks 7-8: shortest paths, MST, network flow

caveats: Greedy algorithms coverage is lighter than UW's treatment
4 credits vs UW's 3 - may need an advisor note on the credit differential
advisorJustification: CS3230 at NUS covers substantially the same core algorithmic paradigms as UW CS 577, including dynamic programming, graph algorithms, and NP-completeness, at comparable depth. The main gap is lighter treatment of greedy algorithms, a minor portion of both syllabi.
